It is one of the largest and most important celebrations in the Islamic calendar. Is Eid-ul-Fitr a Public Holiday?Eid-ul-Fitr is a public holiday. It is a day off for the general population, and schools and most businesses are closed.In 2026, it falls on a Saturday, and some businesses may choose to follow Saturday opening hours.
